note: §3.3a step 2b. Bulk densities for scoopable solids entered by volume. LESS PRECISE than liquid density: a tablespoon of oats varies with how it is packed, a tablespoon of water does not. Each value is derived from a published household-measure gram weight, divided by that measure in millilitres (1 cup = 236.5882365 ml, 1 tbsp = 14.78676478125 ml). The derivation is recorded per class so the number is auditable rather than asserted. Tags are OFF categories_tags fragments (§7.2a) — declared fields, never the product name (§8.3).
